retrievalProfile.description: A three-person group portrait set against a deep blue radial glow with high-contrast branding elements in the corners.
triggerTerms: blue radial glow background with talent
excludeWhen: editorial fashion layouts without graphic overlays

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered group of three individuals in casual attire, framed by a dark blue vignette and a central radial light source. The composition is anchored by a large glossy oval badge in the bottom left and bold sans-serif typography in the bottom right and top right corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects overlap to create depth against a flat background
Radial blue glow highlights the central figure
Glossy metallic textures in the badge contrast with matte clothing textures
Corner-weighted typography balances the central subject mass
coreInvariants: Deep navy to electric blue radial gradient

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged in a triangular formation, waist-up, filling the central 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glossy blue oval badge in the lower-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central face, moves to the top-right numerical callout, then down to the bottom-right text, ending at the bottom-left badge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark blue corners and upper margins provide breathing room for graphic overlays.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Electric Blue (Radial Glow and Badge Accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the center fading to low value at the edges; high saturation in the blue tones.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses wide, geometric capitals with uniform stroke weight
Script text features high-contrast strokes and fluid connections
Numerical elements use heavy weight with inner glow effects
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers feature a vertical cyan-to-white gradient
Script letters have a metallic 3D bevel effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a clean, modern geometric sans for information and a decorative, fluid script for the brand mark.
graphicDevices: Glossy oval badge with concentric rings

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, geometric uppercase look for the season information.
Approximates the fluid, connected energy of the competition branding.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of three diverse young adults in casual clothing against a dark navy background with a bright electric blue radial glow behind the center person. Leave the corners clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a glossy blue oval badge in the bottom left with beveled script text. Place wide-tracked geometric uppercase text in the bottom right and a large gradient-filled number in the top right.

verificationChecks: Is the radial glow centered behind the subjects?
Does the badge have a metallic, 3D appearance?
Is the typography in the bottom right clearly legible and uppercase?
Is the color palette strictly blue, white, and black?

adjustableVariables: Primary brand color (e.g., change blue to red)
postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth blending of the radial glow
Ensure the badge does not obscure the subjects' faces
Verify the 3D effect on the script text is consistent
Confirm the geometric sans-serif is properly tracked
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Radial Glow + Corner Branding Badge + Geometric Info Text
